prompt: The stage crew will keep the scenery’s painted face upright; it can remove a shallow base without disturbing that face. The alley fits the full width but not the height unless the base comes off, while the courtyard is tall enough but still narrower than the face with the gate held halfway. To avoid dividing the painted face, the crew should _____.
promptZh: 舞臺組會讓布景的彩繪面保持直立，並能拆下淺底座而不動彩繪面。小巷夠寬，但除非拆底座，否則高度不夠；庭院夠高，但閘門只能開一半，開口仍窄於彩繪面。為免拆分彩繪面，舞臺組應_____。

options.text: remove the base and take the face upright through the alley
options.zh: 拆下底座，彩繪面保持直立從小巷通過
options.whyZh: 小巷的寬度夠；只拆底座即可解決高度限制並保留整片面板。

options.text: remove the base and take the face upright through the courtyard
options.zh: 拆下底座，彩繪面保持直立從庭院通過
options.whyZh: 底座影響高度，無法解決庭院閘門開口太窄的問題。

options.text: leave the base attached and take the face upright through the alley
options.zh: 不拆底座，彩繪面保持直立從小巷通過
options.whyZh: 小巷寬度夠，但不拆底座時高度不足。

options.text: divide the painted face and take both sections through the courtyard
options.zh: 拆分彩繪面，從庭院搬兩片
options.whyZh: 能搬小塊不代表符合保持整片彩繪面的要求。

explanationZh: 小巷的寬度夠；只拆底座即可解決高度限制並保留整片面板。
evidence: can remove a shallow base without disturbing that face / fits the full width but not the height unless the base comes off / still narrower than the face

vocabulary.note: 搬運物品時用來描述保持垂直的姿態。
